-- Deviation: the stock FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished (FloatingChatFrame.lua:989-992) nils -- oldAlpha even under a live hover, so leaving and re-entering within -- CHAT_FRAME_FADE_TIME (a flick to the scroll buttons, outside the hover box, does it) -- stops the plate fading in (l.873) for the rest of the session; this keeps oldAlpha while -- hover is set. if FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished then function FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished(chatTab, chatFrame) chatTab:Hide() if not chatFrame.hover then chatFrame.oldAlpha = nil end end end
-- Deviation: re-runs UIParent_ManageFramePositions after DurabilityFrame's own OnEvent. The -- pass seats the frame 20 further in while a side glyph shows (UIParent.lua:1759-1768), -- but the stock frame runs it only from OnShow/OnHide, so a glyph appearing while the frame -- is shown leaves the shield's overhang off the screen edge. The stock handler runs first, -- unchanged, on the this/event/arg1 already set for the dispatch. if DurabilityFrame then local refOnEvent = DurabilityFrame:GetScript("OnEvent") DurabilityFrame:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if refOnEvent then refOnEvent() end UIParent_ManageFramePositions() end) end
-- Deviation: friendly plates the player turned on come back at every world entry. The -- stock UpdateNameplates (UIOptionsFrame.lua:768-780) shows them and hides them again at -- once (l.775-776), and FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON is never saved, since l.182 registers -- NAMEPLATES_ON a second time. function UpdateNameplates() if ( NAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowNameplates() else HideNameplates() end if ( FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowFriendNameplates() else HideFriendNameplates() end end RegisterForSave("FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON")
-- The in-world micro buttons must still open their panels in the local session. Keep each -- stock OnClick path, but supply its panel toggle when that handler returns without -- changing visibility (some client handlers early-out on server login state). local function HookMicroPanel(buttonName, panelName) local button = getglobal(buttonName) local panel = getglobal(panelName) if not button or not panel then return end local refOnClick = button:GetScript("OnClick") button:SetScript("OnClick", function(self, clickButton) local wasVisible = panel:IsVisible() if refOnClick then local ok, err = pcall(refOnClick, self, clickButton) if not ok and geterrorhandler then geterrorhandler()(err) end end if panel:IsVisible() == wasVisible then if wasVisible then HideUIPanel(panel) else ShowUIPanel(panel) end end end) end
HookMicroPanel("CharacterMicroButton", "CharacterFrame") HookMicroPanel("SpellbookMicroButton", "SpellBookFrame") HookMicroPanel("TalentMicroButton", "TalentFrame") HookMicroPanel("QuestLogMicroButton", "QuestLogFrame") HookMicroPanel("SocialsMicroButton", "FriendsFrame") HookMicroPanel("WorldMapMicroButton", "WorldMapFrame") HookMicroPanel("MainMenuMicroButton", "GameMenuFrame") HookMicroPanel("HelpMicroButton", "HelpFrame")
-- `UpdateMicroButtons` uses the server's login state for button enablement. The local -- session has no server login packet, so keep the in-world micro row interactive. local microButtonNames = { "CharacterMicroButton", "SpellbookMicroButton", "TalentMicroButton", "QuestLogMicroButton", "SocialsMicroButton", "WorldMapMicroButton", "MainMenuMicroButton", "HelpMicroButton", } local Ref_UpdateMicroButtons = UpdateMicroButtons function UpdateMicroButtons() if Ref_UpdateMicroButtons then Ref_UpdateMicroButtons() end for _, name in ipairs(microButtonNames) do local button = getglobal(name) if button then button:Enable() end end end UpdateMicroButtons()
